audience.en: Seoul salaried resident taxpayers comparing year-end pension contributions with accessible cash, card deductions and qualifying bank jeonse repayments; hypothetical single employee with KRW 62,000,000 gross salary.
audience.ko: 연말 연금 납입, 실제 쓸 수 있는 현금, 카드 소득공제와 요건을 갖춘 은행 전세대출 상환액을 비교하는 서울의 근로소득 거주자이며, 총급여 KRW 62,000,000의 가상 미혼 직장인을 예시로 합니다.

localeReason: Korean serves local salaried residents using Korean payroll, housing-loan and retirement-account terms; English serves readers comparing the same Seoul-specific illustration. Translation does not change residence or eligibility.

conditional_pension_contribution.label: Maximum proposed example contribution, conditional on accessible emergency cash, unused credit room, tax liability and account terms

pension_marginal_tax_reduction.label: National credit plus modeled local effect, not a guaranteed refund or investment return

tax_before_pension.label: Baseline KRW tax including insurance deductions and modeled local component, excluding standard credit; before filing rounding

tax_after_pension.label: Same baseline after eligible pension credit; not refund forecast

planned_card_switch_saving.label: KRW tax reduction when KRW 3,200,000 already-planned credit spending switches to debit under the example conditions

qualifying_jeonse_tax_reduction.label: Conditional bank jeonse saving at 4% annual interest with standard credit already absent

assumptions.persona: Hypothetical Ji-hoon; not facts attributed to the public reader
assumptions.filingScope: Resident employee, full-year work, single, no dependants, no other income; not nonresident or foreign-worker special flat-rate modeling
assumptions.insuranceAmountStatus: Assumed aggregate; replace with actual payroll deductible amounts, not an asserted 2026 premium-rate computation
assumptions.specialCardCategories: None in illustration; excludes overseas, business costs and automobile purchases
assumptions.jeonseEligibility: Unconfirmed; no-home household, head/member eligibility, dwelling size/use/land, listed lender, loan timing and lender-to-landlord transfer require actual documents
assumptions.isaAccessiblePrincipal: unknown; balance is not verified cash or remaining withdrawable contributions
assumptions.pensionCondition: Only after verified accessible emergency cash, unused credit room, sufficient tax liability and acceptable account terms; smaller amount or zero allowed
assumptions.localTaxModel: 10% of modeled national liability; retained review corroborates withholding multiplier, not complete final-settlement certification
assumptions.rounding: Exact illustrative won arithmetic before filing-specific rounding

calculation.referenceReserveFormula: (2000000 monthly card spending + 400000 monthly interest at 4%) * 3; incomplete budget, not universal reserve target

earlyExitScenarios.scope: Full contribution credited, taxable gains, ordinary non-pension cash-out at modeled 16.5%; no uncredited principal or employer tax-deferred retirement money; exceptional treatment, fees, opportunity cost and timing not modeled

proposalTreatment: Youth IRP additional 15% and rent changes remain unconfirmed for enactment/effective year; excluded from every figure and account recommendation

translation.publicationReview: Native Korean editorial review advisable before public publication; parity is not idiomatic certification

datePolicy: Original research date retained as 2026-11-08. Authoring and local arithmetic checks are not fresh external research, current-law certification or publication. Source-specific access dates come from retained sources.md or the mandatory review anchor.
uncertainties: Actual withholding, insurance, existing contributions, other income and credits remain unknown. The totals are conditional planning arithmetic, before filing rounding, not assessed tax or refund forecasts.

The KRW 130,000 standard credit is excluded from the main insurance-deducting baseline. It is not removed a second time for jeonse. Pension marginal remains KRW 396,000 if eligible credit can be used.

ISA balance is not accessible-cash certification. Remaining withdrawable principal, invested assets, market loss, settlement and provider processing require individual checking; KRW 7,200,000 is an incomplete-budget reference only.

No categorical pension-savings-over-IRP recommendation; partial withdrawal and account closure must be checked separately. Pension-phase rates and exceptional early-withdrawal treatment are not established here.
Local-tax withholding multiplier is corroborated in retained review, not freshly fetched by this author and not a full final local-settlement review. The ISA all-in rate remains unconfirmed.
Loan qualification, housing-savings eligibility and forms, broker cutoff and 2027 Hometax/employer deadlines remain unresolved. No exact broker cutoff is promised.
Youth proposal enactment and effective year are unconfirmed and excluded. No tax filing, money contribution, account access, publication, network or browser operation was performed.
Korean is a machine-assisted draft, not native-certified. Parent owns combined checks, inventory and rendering; this author creates only the assigned private-staging files.
